available_tools.probe_service: measure service readiness when the task requires a service
available_tools.raw_bash: run shell commands, compile, execute checks, or inspect specific implementation-critical details
available_tools.search_files: find visible files when the target is not already known
available_tools.search_receipts: search prior evidence instead of rerunning equivalent commands
available_tools.view_receipt: retrieve prior command/file output by receipt id instead of repeating work
available_tools.write_file: create or replace files such as required artifacts

evidence_state.evidence_policy: Evidence should show behaviour against the original task, not only file existence, compilation, non-empty output, or prompt echo.

finalization_boundary.reason: Finalization requires receipt-backed evidence for required outputs and behavior. Avoid repeating compile-only, file-existence-only, non-empty-only, deterministic-only, or smoke-only checks that do not test the functional criterion.

objective: Continue implementation and verification using the model-owned success_contract. Do not re-author the contract unless visible evidence proves it is wrong.
retrieval_hint: Use view_receipt/search_receipts for details instead of repeating equivalent work.

unresolved_requirements.summary: Finalization requires receipt-backed evidence for required outputs and behavior. Avoid repeating compile-only, file-existence-only, non-empty-only, deterministic-only, or smoke-only checks that do not test the functional criterion.
Required artifacts and behavior still need receipt-backed evidence.

args.current_focus: Find a way to access/download the video and extract on-screen text or captions.
evidence_gaps: No transcript or move sequence extracted yet
evidence_required_before_finalization: Receipt-backed comparison or verification against the extracted sequence
implementation_approach: Inspect workspace and available tools for download/access options.
If direct download tools are unavailable, look for any visible helper scripts or browserless extraction utilities in the workspace.
Extract the move sequence from the video content using whatever visible evidence is obtainable.
Write the moves one per line to /app/solution.txt.
known_bad_behavior: Guessing moves from memory or external sources
next_steps: Acquire or access the video content
args.objective: Produce /app/solution.txt with the full ordered list of Zork moves from the referenced video, based on the video itself.
risks: Video may require alternate access methods if direct download is unavailable
validation_strategy: Confirm the extracted sequence is grounded in visible video evidence.
Check that /app/solution.txt contains the same ordered moves.
Prefer evidence from receipts over assumptions.
verification_test_strategy: Use the strongest visible check available after extraction, such as comparing the written file to the extracted transcript or frame notes.
Avoid treating file existence alone as sufficient.

working_checklist.usage: Editable model-owned checklist. Update it when evidence changes. Do not treat it as a harness gate.

workspace_state.state_policy: This is workspace state, not a checklist to game. Existence alone is not success.
